name: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited
summary: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and retail of various gold and precious stone studded jewelry products in India, the Middle East, the United states of America, and United Kingdom, and internationally. It offers gold, diamond, silver, platinum, gemstone, and white and rose gold jewelry, including wedding, staple regional, aspirational, studded, and other jewelries. The company also provides chains, necklaces, bangles, bracelets, nose studs, choker, jewelry, and moti sets, daily wear, vaddanam, rings, earrings, pendants, anklets, pearls, studs, jhumka, lockets, harams, kadas, payals, and second studs.
